title: SEC Suspends Trading of QMMM Holdings Amid Crypto Treasury Manipulation Probe
summary: The SEC has suspended trading of QMMM Holdings, citing concerns over potential stock manipulation linked to the firm’s recent pivot into crypto holdings. The post SEC Suspends Trading of QMMM Holdings Amid Crypto Treasury Manipulation Probe appeared first on Cryptonews .

title: French Inflation Quickens But Remains Well Short of ECB Goal
summary: French inflation picked up on an acceleration in the services sector and smaller declines in energy prices, though remained well below the European Central Bank’s 2% target.
